data: Which of the following is NOT a beam size used in the performance comparison between CTC and CTCC?

The caption states that the performance comparison between CTC and CTCC uses different sizes of beam for LM rescoring. The figure shows two graphs labeled TH and TH-CS, each with lines representing CTC and CTCC. The x-axis of both graphs is labeled 'beam width' and includes values of 64, 128, 256, 512, and 1024. 

To determine which beam size is not used in the performance comparison, we need to identify if any value other than these five is present on the x-axis. Since all the values on the x-axis correspond to the specified beam sizes, there is no additional value that would indicate a beam size not used in the comparison. Therefore, the question implies that one of the listed beam sizes is missing from the comparison, but since all the listed values are present, none of them are NOT used in the comparison. 

Thus, the answer is that none of the listed beam sizes are NOT used in the performance comparison.
